vol.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe #7
desc: Below Snake Mountain, He-Man enters the catacombs of Vy-Por with both allies and enemies by his side. Above, the Heroic Warriors join forces with the Snake Men and prepare for battle against Skeletor and his army of Aquaticans, Beast Men, and Evil Warriors. It's good and evil versus evil and eviler!
